description: Graph instances produced by the seeded generator in core/generator.py and verified against the BFS oracle before export. Each unreachable case is cut from the reachable case beside it, so the pair matches on node count and edge count exactly.

evidence.source: Seeded distance-stratified generator, core/generator.py. Reproducible with python export_web.py.

line.description: Four-hop line. Target becomes active at R = 4.

line_short.description: Two-hop line. Target becomes active at R = 2.

branch.description: Branching graph. Target becomes active at R = 3.

diamond.description: Diamond graph. Target becomes active at R = 2.

cycle.description: Directed cycle. Target becomes active at R = 4.

disconnected.description: Disconnected graph. Target never becomes active.

matching.description: Mean node-local statistics of the exported bank. Node and edge counts match exactly by construction; the remaining gaps are reported rather than hidden.
